name: Uterine sarcoma
theme: the accidental diagnosis · histology is the disease

meta.title: Uterine sarcoma in silico decision trainer
meta.condition: Uterine sarcomas (leiomyosarcoma, low-grade and high-grade endometrial stromal sarcoma, undifferentiated uterine sarcoma, adenosarcoma), adult
meta.population: Adults with uterine sarcoma - THE ACCIDENTAL DIAGNOSIS: many uterine leiomyosarcomas are found incidentally in surgery for presumed fibroids, no preoperative technique reliably discriminates (verified receipts - 'imaging characteristics highly predictive of LMS remain largely undefined'), and the FDA's morcellation saga (2014 communication, 1-in-350 meta-estimate; 2017 revision 1/570-1/750 for LMS; 2020 containment guidance secondhand) is a signature regulatory teaching arc. HISTOLOGY IS THE DISEASE: uLMS, low-grade ESS (JAZF1-SUZ12, hormone-driven, indolent-with-late-recurrence), high-grade ESS/UUS (YWHAE-NUTM2, BCOR memory-grade), and adenosarcoma are four different diseases sharing an organ - and CARCINOSARCOMA is none of them: it is metaplastic high-grade endometrial CARCINOMA (verified receipts) and reroutes LIVE to the endometrial trainer (the registry's ninth live reroute). The incidence disparity is verified: Black women carry roughly twice the uterine-sarcoma incidence (race-stratified SEER/USCS receipts matched) - and the briefing's per-million incidence figure hit a UNIT TRAP (the verified snippets are per 100,000), so no raw incidence number ships unchecked.
meta.summary: Evidence-linked teaching application for the accidental diagnosis. THE MORCELLATION ARC anchors the surgical chapter: the FDA's 2014 communication (1-in-350 occult-sarcoma meta-estimate), the 2017 downward revision (LMS 1/570-1/750), the 2020 containment guidance (secondhand), intact-specimen-first surgery - with the outcomes literature carried at its honest, CONFLICTED grade (recurrence/upstaging effects more consistent than OS effects; the attribution trap documented: 1-in-350 is the FDA's number, not Park's). THE ADJUVANT HONESTY is precise: GOG-277 (PMID-verified) closed for ACCRUAL futil…
meta.disclaimer: Synthetic teaching environment. Not medical advice; every number is a claim with a citation and an expiry date.
meta.classification: FIGO 2009 sarcoma-specific staging VERIFIED (Prat, PMID-matched: LMS/ESS stage I uterus-limited, IA <=5cm / IB >5cm; adenosarcoma by myoinvasion) - better than the memory grade the briefing allowed; WHO histotypes with fusion receipts verified (JAZF1-SUZ12 LG-ESS; YWHAE-NUTM2 HG-ESS; BCOR memory-grade, tagged)
meta.response: Recurrence/PFS/OS at their verified grades: LMS-04 final analysis median OS 33.08 vs 23.78 months (HR 0.65 - verified snippet via NEJM/DOI, PMID unmatched and flagged); trabectedin mPFS 4.2 vs 1.5 (verified); pazopanib mPFS 4.6 vs 1.6 (verified); eribulin's LMS subgroup NULL (12.7 vs 13.0 months, verified) - the scope traps ARE the response standard's teaching

Newly diagnosed.name: Hysterectomy (intact) + restraint (uterus-limited uLMS)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: the uterus-limited uLMS standard (NCCN secondhand; restraint receipts verified)
Newly diagnosed.evidence: verified restraint chapter (GOG-277, EORTC 55874, Kapp/NCDB/meta); figure flagged
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: one operation - the restraint chapter's point is what is NOT added
Newly diagnosed.patient: For leiomyosarcoma confined to the uterus: removing the uterus in one piece is the treatment - and adding chemotherapy or radiation afterward has been properly tested and never shown to help, so careful watching is a legitimate, evidence-based choice.

Newly diagnosed.name: Hysterectomy + BSO, the debate carried (uterus-limited LG-ESS)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: the LG-ESS convention (NCCN secondhand; debate receipts verified)
Newly diagnosed.evidence: convention + verified split BSO receipts + verified contraindication; figure flagged
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: surgical menopause where BSO - the debate's real currency in young patients
Newly diagnosed.patient: For the slow-growing hormonal type confined to the uterus: surgery removing the uterus and usually both ovaries - because this cancer feeds on estrogen - with survival that is genuinely excellent measured in decades.

Newly diagnosed.name: Hysterectomy + staging (uterus-limited HG-ESS/UUS or adenosarcoma)
Newly diagnosed.evidence: verified fusion biology + convention; figure flagged
Newly diagnosed.patient: For the aggressive stromal type and for adenosarcoma confined to the uterus: surgery first, with any added treatment decided by the exact type and its risk features.

Newly diagnosed.name: Doxorubicin-based first line, LMS-04-updated (advanced uLMS)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: doxorubicin-based first line (GeDDiS-anchored); LMS-04 layered for fit patients (off-label, said)
Newly diagnosed.evidence: randomized phase 3 receipts (LMS-04 OS verified-snippet/PMID-flagged; GeDDiS verified)
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: anthracycline + trabectedin ledgers - the OS win is bought with real combination toxicity (higher-but-manageable, per the trial)
Newly diagnosed.patient: For spread leiomyosarcoma: chemotherapy built on doxorubicin - and for fit patients, adding trabectedin showed the first survival improvement this disease has seen in decades (nine extra months in the trial).
drugs: Doxorubicin +/- trabectedin (LMS-04; off-label combination in the US)

Newly diagnosed.name: Aromatase-inhibitor backbone (advanced LG-ESS)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: the hormone backbone (verified receipts; NCCN secondhand)
Newly diagnosed.evidence: verified hormonal-therapy receipts (series-grade by disease rarity); figure flagged
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: menopausal-spectrum effects - a pill's ledger against a decades clock
Newly diagnosed.patient: For the slow hormonal type even when it has spread: estrogen-blocking pills are the treatment - this disease is managed over years to decades, often with surgery for individual spots.
drugs: Letrozole (or other AI); progestins as alternative

Newly diagnosed.name: Imported cytotoxics, labeled (advanced HG-ESS/UUS or adenosarcoma)
Newly diagnosed.evidence: imported (said); verified case-series receipts where they exist
Newly diagnosed.patient: For the rare aggressive stromal types when spread: chemotherapy borrowed honestly from the leiomyosarcoma playbook - these diseases are too rare to have trials of their own, and the trainer says so.
drugs: Doxorubicin-based (imported from the uLMS ladder, labeled)

Newly diagnosed.name: Comfort-focused care
Newly diagnosed.guideline: always on the menu, never by drift
Newly diagnosed.patient: Comfort-focused care is a real choice at every step.

refs.label: GOG-277/NRG (Hensley): adjuvant gem+doce->dox vs OBSERVATION, high-grade uterus-limited uLMS (PMID 30289732, pubmed-url-match; NCT01533207): closed by NCI for ACCRUAL FUTILITY at 38 of 216 (verified snippet) - the trial could NOT show benefit rather than showed none (teach precisely); chemo-arm outcomes numerically worse (RMST 34.3 vs 46.4 secondhand); Gr3-4 toxicity 47% of treated vs one Gr3 event on observation (verified). SARC 005 - the hypothesis-generating phase 2 it failed to confirm - PMID 23335221 (matched). Observation legitimate: guideline-consistent, secondhand

EORTC 55874: adjuvant pelvic RT, stages I-II uterine sarcoma (PMID 18378136, pubmed-url-match): 224 patients (verified snippet) - improved local control, NO OS/PFS benefit (direction snippet-consistent; LC numbers memory-grade) - routine adjuvant pelvic RT retired

THE NO-ROUTINE-NODES RECEIPTS, all matched: Kapp 1,396-patient SEER analysis (PMID 18189292 - lymphadenectomy and oophorectomy no independent survival impact; median age 52 verified); NCDB corroborator (28317559, matched); meta-analysis (36308940, matched - no lymphadenectomy benefit)

THE FDA MORCELLATION ARC (verified-secondhand via fda.gov/acog.org links returned): 2014-04-17 safety communication - power morcellation DISCOURAGED, occult-sarcoma meta-estimate 1-IN-350 (verified snippet); Nov 2014 contraindications (peri/postmenopausal, suspected malignancy); 2017 update - sarcoma 1/305-1/360, LMS-SPECIFIC 1/570-1/750 (verified snippet); Dec 2020 containment-system guidance - page exists, 2020 text NOT snippet-confirmed (secondhand); ACOG 2021 committee opinion (link returned). THE ATTRIBUTION TRAP taught: 1-in-350 is the FDA's meta-estimate, NOT Park's number (Park = outcomes, FDA = prevalence)

MORCELLATION OUTCOMES, at their honest CONFLICTED grade: Pritts systematic review (PMID 25193444, pubmed-url-match - occult uLMS in 0.1-0.2% of presumed-leiomyoma hysterectomies); intraperitoneal-morcellation cohort (24923260, matched - increased recurrence, shortened time-to-recurrence, upstaging at re-exploration); Park LG-ESS morcellation paper (21541824, matched). THE FLAG: Park's uLMS paper (Gynecol Oncol 2011;122:255-9) NEVER url-matched - cited by journal/year, NO PMID assigned. The literature's RFS effect is consistent; the OS effect is NOT - said. Occult-prevalence corroborators matched: 29251674, 26699101, 25765878 (age-gradient)

NO RELIABLE PREOPERATIVE DISCRIMINATOR (verified): 'imaging characteristics highly predictive of LMS remain largely undefined' / 'no preoperative technique reliably differentiates' (PMID 25400500, pubmed-url-match; review 35884577, matched) - MRI+LDH best-available, not reliable; the diagnosis is usually retrospective

FIGO 2009 sarcoma-specific staging VERIFIED (Prat, PMID 19135669, pubmed-url-match - better than the memory grade the briefing allowed): LMS/ESS stage I uterus-limited, IA <=5cm / IB >5cm; adenosarcoma IA no myoinvasion / IB <=half / IC >half; II pelvis; III abdomen. Companion 39016324 matched; FIGO/AJCC comparative validity 19647426 matched

THE FUSION RECEIPTS, matched: LG-ESS - JAZF1-JJAZ1(SUZ12) t(7;17) 'frequent fusion' (PMID 11371647) + ~60% detection (26879382) + PRC2 disruption (27845897); HG-ESS - YWHAE-NUTM2A/B t(10;17) clinicopathology (22456610 - 10/12 presenting stage II-III vs 4/16 for JAZF1), cyclin D1 marker (22982899), chemo-response series (28390819). BCOR-rearranged HG-ESS: MEMORY-GRADE (WHO 2020), tagged, not searched

THE ESS HORMONE CHAPTER, verified: 'Hormonal therapy of endometrial stromal sarcoma' (PMID 17545798, pubmed-url-match - 'Estrogen replacement therapy and tamoxifen are CONTRAINDICATED'; recurrences attributed to inadvertent stimulation); letrozole long-term outcome (26495759, matched); progestins effective/poorly tolerated (16368128, matched). The contraindication is property-enforced: tamoxifen on NO card

THE BSO DEBATE, carried on verified SPLIT receipts: ovarian preservation in stage I LG-ESS - no effect on recurrence/OS in some series (PMID 16319256, matched; 153-case sparing series 24412112, matched) VS ovary-sparing as independent adverse relapse factor (NCDB premenopausal stage I, 32354469, matched). Guideline convention = BSO (secondhand); the evidence is genuinely contested - taught as debate, not settled

CARCINOSARCOMA = metaplastic high-grade endometrial CARCINOMA (verified, multiple matches: 33183764, 34852949, 25805398, 36585027 - monoclonal epithelial origin, EMT-derived sarcomatous component; 'previously considered sarcomas') - the impostor rerouted LIVE to the endometrial trainer (the registry's ninth live reroute)

LMS-04 (French Sarcoma Group): dox+trabectedin (then trabectedin maintenance) vs dox alone, FIRST-LINE LMS - 2022 primary (Lancet Oncol, PMID 35835135, pubmed-url-match: PFS significantly longer); 2024 FINAL ANALYSIS (NEJM, DOI 10.1056/NEJMoa2403394 - PMID NEVER url-matched, FLAGGED): mOS 33.08 vs 23.78 months, HR 0.65, p=0.0253; mPFS 12.19 vs 6.21, HR 0.37 (verified snippet) - the first first-line OS win in LMS in decades. THE BRIEFING WAS UPDATED (it froze at the PFS result). OFF-LABEL in the US (no label change, no US trial - said). LMS-02 phase 2 precursor matched (25795402)

GeDDiS: gem+doce vs doxorubicin FIRST-LINE STS incl. uLMS (PMID 28882536, pubmed-url-match): NO difference in 6-month PFS / median PFS / OS (verified snippet) - gem/doce is NOT superior; doxorubicin(-based) remains the first-line anchor

TRABECTEDIN - THE CORRECTED SCOPE (the stack's 10th premise correction): ET743-SAR-3007 phase 3 (Demetri, PMID 26371143, pubmed-url-match) enrolled L-SARCOMAS ONLY (liposarcoma + leiomyosarcoma - NOT broad STS as the briefing hedged): 518 pts post-anthracycline, mPFS 4.2 vs 1.5 months (verified snippet); FDA approval 2015-10-23 explicitly INCLUDES leiomyosarcoma - trabectedin is ON-LABEL for uLMS post-anthracycline. uLMS subgroup paper matched (28651804); OS/histology update matched (31173362)

PALETTE: pazopanib vs placebo, pretreated STS (PMID 22595799, pubmed-url-match): 369 pts, mPFS 4.6 vs 1.6 months (verified snippet); FDA-approved for advanced non-adipocytic STS - covers uLMS. THE MIRROR SCOPE NOTE (memory-grade): PALETTE EXCLUDED liposarcoma - the mirror image of the eribulin trap, flagged in the teaching

THE ERIBULIN SCOPE TRAP (property-enforced - never carded): phase 3 eribulin vs dacarbazine (Schoffski, PMID 26874885, pubmed-url-match): OS benefit driven by LIPOSARCOMA; LMS subgroup mOS 12.7 vs 13.0 months - NULL (verified snippet); FDA approval is LIPOSARCOMA-ONLY. The recurring wrong-answer magnet, kept off the menu with its receipt printed

THE IO CHAPTER - one verified zero + one verified exception: SARC028 pembrolizumab (PMID 28988646, pubmed-url-match): 0 of 10 LMS patients responded (verified snippet - the briefing's '~0' confirmed EXACTLY); KEYNOTE-158 dMMR/MSI-H tumor-agnostic (31682550 initial + 35680043/39979665 updates, matched): ORR 33.8%, mDoR 63.2 months (verified snippet). Property-enforced: no checkpoint inhibitor carded; the exception is a testing-and-route note

EPI with a UNIT TRAP flagged: SEER 2,677-case series (15047237, matched; median uLMS age 52) + 13,089-case series (27177280, matched) + USCS racial-disparity receipt (33722415, matched: Black women ~2x uterine-sarcoma incidence - LMS 1.51 vs 0.91 per 100,000 verified snippet; 2-4x for LMS/carcinosarcoma after hysterectomy correction). THE TRAP: the briefing's '3-7 per million' conflicts with verified per-100,000 snippets - NO raw incidence number ships unchecked; the disparity receipt is the verified content

THE THINNED LANDSCAPE (2025's two deaths + one confabulation corrected): SUNRISE-LMS (NCT05269355, unesbulin/PTC596 + DTIC) TERMINATED ~2025-05 as a 'business decision' - and the briefing's 'unifiram' was a CONFABULATED name (a nootropic with no oncology program; the stack's 11th premise correction - the real agent was unesbulin); Alliance A092104 (NCT05432791, olaparib+TMZ vs IC) FAILED primary PFS (ASCO 2025), closed for futility 2025-10 (the NCI-10250 phase-2 ORR-27% signal killed at randomized scale; results paper PMID unmatched - cite trial IDs); APROMISS (NCT03016819) LMS cohort closed/read out ASCO 2025 - result direction UNVERIFIED (comparator described inconsistently across sources - conflict said)

THE SHELF + EMPTY BUCKETS, said plainly: SaLuDo (NCT06088290, lurbinectedin+dox first-line LMS ph IIb/III) - US SITES UNCONFIRMED this sweep (LOUD flag: only a Spain listing surfaced; the Dana-Farber precursor makes US sites plausible - NOT listed as a US door until registry check); INVINCIBLE-3 (INT230-6) funding-paused-then-limited-resumed (fragile - counseled with caution); botensilimab/balstilimab sarcoma expansion (2/16 LMS PRs) - status STALE/uncertain. EMPTY: ESS-dedicated US (BFR-ESS/FUCHSia are European), adenosarcoma-dedicated, morcellation-prevention interventional, ctDNA-interventional, TCR/TIL-accepting-LMS (Tecelra/lete-cel are synovial/MRCLS), NRG/SWOG gyn-sarcoma (activity migrated to GOG Partners)

El-Jawahri A, LeBlanc T, VanDusen H, et al. Effect of Inpatient Palliative Care on Quality of Life 2 Weeks After Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation: A Randomized Clinical Trial. JAMA 2016;316(20):2094-2103 (PMID 27893130, NCT02207322) — abstract read firsthand 2026-09-10. POPULATION CAUTION, added at that read because the previous label named no population at all: this is a SINGLE-INSTITUTION randomized trial of 160 adults with HAEMATOLOGICAL malignancy hospitalized for autologous or allogeneic stem-cell transplantation, and its outcomes are quality of life, depression, anxiety, fatigue and symptom burden — it reports no survival and no adverse-event table. It is the factory's standing anchor for the PRINCIPLE that palliative care runs alongside active treatment rather than after it; it is not evidence in this tumour type and is not the source of any number on this card.

GOG-3088 (NCT05649956, GOG Partners): randomized phase II, adjuvant LETROZOLE vs observation, FIGO 2009 stage I uLMS - PFS primary; started 2024-07; est. primary completion 2028-07 - RECRUITING per secondary sources ~2026-03 - WEB-VERIFIED 2026-08-20, registry re-check due (ER-eligibility details unverified). The only adjuvant door after GOG-277 - and it is hormonal

STC-15 (NCT06975293, STORM Therapeutics): first-in-class oral METTL3 (RNA-methylation) inhibitor, open-label phase 2 Simon two-stage, relapsed LMS (uterine INCLUDED) + DD liposarcoma - OPEN/ENROLLING, ~3+ US sites per sponsor/advocacy sources (site count NOT registry-confirmed) - WEB-VERIFIED 2026-08-20, re-check due. The one novel-mechanism LMS-named US door; small-biotech funding risk said
